description: Student of software engineering learning to apply my skills across research disciplines like earth science, aerospace and health. Interested in working with people from a range of backgrounds and experiences to solve the big problems.
summary: A data visualisation and exploration tool for NASA POWER and the Meteomatics API for meteorology in the UK, focusing on rainfall (in mm) as a relatively unpredictable but hugely important natural phenomenon.
details: It is a toolkit to support students and researchers in analysing rainfall patterns and making future predictions based on data. It includes a Jupyter Notebook file with some statistical modelling experiments, showing some success in predicting future rainfall based on historical patterns, but richer data is needed. This is where NASA and other world organisations must come together to share knowledge and understanding, to tackle issues of water poverty, flooding and drought.
